sample_steps.description: Read quarterly inputs and retain historical bank entities.
sample_steps.rule: Read 1984Q1–1992Q4 for origin. Validate quarter against RSSD9999 or DATE. Keep RSSD9048==200 and CALL8786 in {1,2}; use RSSD9331==1 as a consistency audit, not an extra automatic filter. Exclude office-only and nonbank records. Maintain RSSD9001 identity across name changes; no holding-company aggregation.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p9 Sample and data; DOC01 p4 banking context
sample_steps.ambiguity: Exact commercial-bank screening codes are not supplied. Origin uses charter as primary classification; disagreements or reporting level 0 require an explicit unresolved log.

sample_steps.description: Define annual market population before analytic deletions.
sample_steps.rule: At Q4 each year, select banks whose zero-padded RSSD9210 and RSSD9150 concatenate to county_fips5 in the 1983-06-27 definition for area_code 5120. Include both MN and WI member counties. Membership is contemporaneous; maintain annual eligible sets U_t.
sample_steps.ambiguity: Article says Minneapolis–St. Paul, Minnesota metropolitan area, without counties or boundary vintage. Restricting to MN or using RSSD9180 can change membership.

sample_steps.description: Build annual bank records without imposing survival.
sample_steps.rule: For each eligible RSSD9001 and year, use Q4 income flows and Q4 strategy/deposit stocks. Compute annual average assets from the four within-year RCFD3368 observations, requiring all four in origin. Do not sum cumulative income across quarters. Retain entry/exit as observed; do not backfill absorbed institutions or require a balanced panel.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p9 Sample and data; Dependent variable
sample_steps.ambiguity: Within-year averaging and handling partial-year banks and merger-year income are not specified. Origin follows as-reported legal-entity amounts.

sample_steps.description: Construct market benchmarks before imposing regression completeness.
sample_steps.rule: Compute each annual mean strategy share and sample SD over nonmissing eligible banks in U_t for that strategy. Compute unweighted mean ROA over eligible U_t banks with valid ROA. Market deposits sum deposits for all U_t, but mark the aggregate missing if any included bank deposit is missing. Store coverage counts for audit. Compute these statistics before excluding named bank-year or requiring lagged outcomes.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p9 Dependent and independent variables; DOC01 p10 strategic-deviation equation
sample_steps.ambiguity: Article says all Twin Cities banks but does not specify available-case versus joint-complete benchmark populations or whether means are recomputed after deletions.

sample_steps.description: Construct outcome, controls and focal terms.
sample_steps.rule: Apply variable definitions below at t. Compute growth using t and t-1 market totals and price indices. Require positive total and average assets and positive price indices; zero strategy amounts are valid observed amounts.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p10 Variables; DOC01 p11 Model 3 equation
sample_steps.ambiguity: Zero/invalid denominators and missing category rules are unreported; origin guards against undefined arithmetic rather than imputing.

sample_steps.rule: Join relative_ROA_scaled at year t-1 on RSSD9001. Never shift across bank boundaries or skip calendar gaps. Compute lag from the pre-exclusion panel. Do not construct a synthetic predecessor aggregate in origin.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p10 Lagged dependent variable; DOC01 p11 Analysis autocorrelation
sample_steps.ambiguity: Merger-chain continuity is unspecified. A bank-year excluded as a regression row can still supply its observed value as a later lag in origin.

sample_steps.description: Apply analytic window and named exclusion.
sample_steps.rule: Keep outcome years 1985 through 1992. Exclude Norwest Bank Minneapolis, N.A. at year 1987 after locating its historical RSSD9001 from RSSD9010 and event-name/certificate evidence; preserve the crosswalk audit. Do not use a residual threshold to search for replacement exclusions.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p11 Analysis outlier paragraph; DOC01 p9 Sample and data
sample_steps.ambiguity: The numeric bank identifier is unavailable in supplied descriptions. If identity cannot be uniquely established, flag pending resolution rather than deleting a guessed bank.

sample_steps.description: Use a common complete-case estimation sample for nested models.
sample_steps.rule: Keep rows with finite outcome, lag, all focal terms, all four controls, and strictly positive market-share precision weight. Use the same rows for M1, M2, M3 and the separately reported M3_SQ diagnostic. Log each loss reason without targeting any published count.
sample_steps.source: DOC01 p11 Analysis hierarchical regression; DOC01 p12 Table 2
sample_steps.ambiguity: Missingness and order of deletion are not documented. Common rows are necessary for the specified nested SSE comparisons.

sample_steps.description: Estimate only after the independent reader stage and specification freeze.
sample_steps.rule: Pass this manifest and reconciled axis levels to an implementer; preserve an immutable configuration and exclusion log. This reader does not fit models.
sample_steps.ambiguity: Execution governance supplied by rules/reader_rules.md, not an article claim.

variables.name: strategic_deviation
variables.definition: For each of the eleven share_* variables a, calculate mu_a,t=unweighted mean among eligible nonmissing banks in U_t and sd_a,t=sqrt(sum((share_a-mu_a,t)^2)/(count_a,t-1)). D_i,t=sum_a(abs((share_a,i,t-mu_a,t)/sd_a,t)). Require all eleven contributions.
variables.transformations: Sum absolute z scores, not mean, signed sum, squared Euclidean distance or pairwise distance.
variables.ambiguity: SD divisor and benchmark complete-case population not stated. If a strategy SD is zero, origin treats its contribution as 0 for banks equal to the common value and logs the convention; if fewer than two valid banks, benchmark undefined.
variables.source: DOC01 p10 Strategic-deviation equation

variables.name: strategic_deviation_sq
variables.transformations: Square the sum after absolute-value aggregation.
variables.ambiguity: Do not sum squared individual z scores; centering is an algebraic alternative only with coefficient back-transformation.

value.origin: No AR correction; test assumed first-order error correlation using Durbin h.
value.ordering: Sort by bank_id then year; only contiguous within-bank year pairs; insert separators or enforce grouped operations.
value.diagnostic_formula: Conventional h=rho_hat*sqrt(n/(1-n*Var(beta_lag))) when denominator positive; report undefined otherwise. Record whether residuals/covariance come from OLS diagnostic or weighted fit.
value.ambiguity: Article does not specify pooled rho weighting, observation count for gaps, or whether h used pre-WLS versus final residuals. Do not treat a finite negative h as nonsignificant merely because below a positive bound.

value.rule: Exclude the historically identified bank-year specified in S07; calculate studentized deleted residuals only as diagnostics, not as a rule to discover additional exclusions.
value.order: Origin benchmarks and lags built before row exclusion.

value.rule: Provider missing remains missing; no default zero filling. Use S04 available-case benchmark convention and S08 common analytic completeness. Missing annual-average quarters make annual denominator missing. Invalid positive denominators and nonpositive WLS weights cannot enter fits.

value.formula: F=((SSE_R-SSE_U)/q)/(SSE_U/(n-rank(X_U))) using weighted SSE and same rows/weights; df=(q,n-rank(X_U)); upper-tail F test
value.additional: For M3 report sign of quadratic, turning point -b_D/(2*b_D2) if b_D2<0, observed D bounds and slopes at bounds. In-range conclusion requires observed support; no extra slope-test criterion is attributed to publication. M3_SQ is a separate reported diagnostic; it is not nested in M2.
